authority.user_instruction: Build and evaluate a polished loopback-only read-only evidence dashboard from verified IncidentSeal records without changing the product promise, workflow authority, Docker trust boundary, stable verification CLI, or evidence-state semantics.

scope.objective: Define, implement, render, and evaluate a polished local evidence dashboard plus a deterministic scenario corpus and repeated-trial report on top of checkpoint-is-0004.
forbidden_work: Changing the approved product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, stable verification CLI, or evidence semantics
Giving a dashboard process Docker authority, approval-write authority, secrets, external network, or repository workflow execution
Binding the dashboard server to a non-loopback interface
Treating a mutable database or rendered dashboard as more authoritative than exact receipts and checkpoint records
Collapsing PASS, FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, INVALID, cancelled, failed, stale, or superseded evidence
Using external fonts, analytics, telemetry, CDN assets, paid services, accounts, or secrets
Adding cloud, Kubernetes, multi-tenancy, arbitrary remote execution, registry, packaging, or release work
Using a dependency before its exact source, integrity, license, vulnerability, and compatibility gate passes
Claiming dashboard or evaluation completion from source inspection, unit tests, or synthetic screenshots alone
reversible_actions: Create closed dashboard snapshot and scenario schemas, fixtures, locks, mutation harnesses, ADRs, and documentation
Implement a dependency-free read-only evidence projection and separate dashboard launcher without changing the frozen verification CLI dispatcher
Serve only repository-controlled static assets and verified read-only projections over loopback
Create fixed synthetic scenario fixtures that preserve every evidence and lifecycle distinction
Run local browser, accessibility, responsive-layout, security-header, and failure-state checks
Measure repeated-trial correctness, latency, resource use, and claim calibration without external telemetry
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A required change would alter the product promise, trust boundary, workflow approval authority, stable verification CLI, or weaken an explicit security or evidence gate
The dashboard cannot remain loopback-only and read-only
A projection cannot prove exact source-record and checkpoint identity
A dependency or artifact cannot pass its source gate
A test would require a secret, real sensitive data, paid service, access change, consequential action, or irreversible operation
A rendered or measured claim cannot be reproduced from clean public custody

units.purpose: Freeze the read-only evidence projection, loopback server, dashboard state model, scenario corpus, visual acceptance, and evaluation contracts before implementation.
retained_failures: One read-only candidate-inspection wrapper left HEAD^{tree} unquoted under PowerShell and was INVALID before the corrected quoted query returned exact commit f6589bc4 and tree aa4d6484. No server, browser, Docker runtime, approval write, or workflow action occurred.

The first public authority assertion wrapper inspected data.approval_status instead of policy.approval_status after the product correctly returned MISSING / INVALID / exit 12. The corrected read-only wrapper passed under invocation 9cb57896; no product runtime or authority mutation occurred.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Exact public custody reproduced the source-bound snapshot, nine-case repeated corpus, two closed schemas, 37 fail-closed mutations, 111 tests, offline full-schema evaluation, Git and secret integrity, missing approval, and zero product runtime.

units.purpose: Implement a dependency-free, exact-record-bound projection and separate loopback-only read-only dashboard launcher without changing the frozen verification CLI.
retained_failures: Three real-launcher attempts remain INVALID: an initially unclassified connection reset, the diagnosed final-request thread-shutdown race, and a stale exact-lock startup-envelope assertion. Each cleanup left zero dashboard processes, unchanged repository custody, no Docker runtime change, no approval write, and no workflow execution. Three passing earlier implementations remain superseded after the final scenario renderer and documentation lock changed.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Exact public custody proves the real server, projection, local assets, read-only HTTP behavior, security headers, attack denial, authority boundary, and teardown. EXIT-READ-ONLY-DASHBOARD remains pending until U03 proves the actual rendered desktop/mobile, keyboard, accessibility, overflow, and failure-state surfaces.

units.purpose: Verify the rendered dashboard across desktop and mobile layouts, keyboard and screen-reader structure, missing/corrupt evidence, and loopback security behavior.
retained_failures: Two real rendered product failures remain retained: revision 1 failed the frozen 4.5:1 text-contrast gate and revision 2 failed the frozen 44 CSS pixel mobile touch-target gate. Revision 3 corrected both before the browser lock was frozen.

Thirteen local evaluator attempts remain INVALID without product claims, including unsupported browser capabilities, invalid screenshot handling, wrapper defects, and strict-lock domain rejection; each was corrected with an independently bounded check.

The first public replay project-probe wrapper remains INVALID because detached HEAD produced an empty branch string; the entire exact-commit replay restarted from its first gate on a local no-track branch and passed without changing remote, commit, tree, or custody.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: Exact public custody reproduced the real desktop and all nine mobile states, calibrated claims, semantic and keyboard behavior, responsive and visual gates, local-only requests, static and runtime validation, missing approval, zero workflow execution, and unchanged Docker custody.

units.purpose: Run the deterministic scenario corpus repeatedly and publish a claim-calibrated correctness, latency, resource, recovery, and evidence-completeness evaluation.
retained_failures: Five local evaluator or evidence-wrapper attempts remain INVALID, including a nonexistent schema path, an unsupported protected-volume label assumption, a PowerShell environment-binding parser error, a malformed evidence patch delimiter, and a policy-status command missing its required manifest. None created a product claim.
One complete pre-lock 27-trial PASS calibration remains superseded by the exact evaluation lock and locked candidate dataset; it is not promoted as U04 evidence.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The portfolio claim requires measured repeated outcomes and explicit non-claims, not a curated success screenshot.

units.purpose: Commit, push, credential-free clean-clone, replay, mark, and independently verify the bounded IS-0005 dashboard-and-evaluation checkpoint.

exit_condition_delta.rationale: The milestone closes only after exact public custody reproduces the rendered dashboard, scenario corpus, measurements, and marker.

Deterministic success, product-failure, invalid-input, missing-evidence, policy-attack, isolation-attack, corrupt-receipt, crash, and recovery scenarios
